moments.title: European Athletics Championships in Birmingham
moments.blurb: The 2026 European Athletics Championships are ongoing in Birmingham, with Great Britain celebrating multiple gold medals, including Matthew Hudson-Smith in the 400m and Amy Hunt and Romell Glave in the 100m.

angles.name: Gold Rush
angles.copy: Team GB are absolutely flying at the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham! What a week for British sport.

angles.name: Hudson-Smith Heroics
angles.copy: Matthew Hudson-Smith, what a run! Another gold for Team GB in the 400m at the European Athletics Championships. Birmingham is buzzing!

moments.title: Community Shield this weekend in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, the traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season, takes place this Sunday, August 16, between Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners Manchester City at Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: It's almost time! The Community Shield kicks off the new football season this Sunday in Cardiff. Who are you backing, Arsenal or Man City?

angles.name: Cardiff Host
angles.copy: Cardiff takes centre stage for the FA Community Shield this Sunday! Huge match between Arsenal and Man City at Principality Stadium. Are you heading down?

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Season Kicks Off Next Week
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season is set to kick off next weekend, starting on Friday, August 21, marking the return of top-flight English football.

angles.name: Anticipation Builds
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League returns next Friday. Who's going to hit the ground running this season?

angles.name: New Season Hopes
angles.copy: New season, new hopes! The Premier League kicks off next week. Will your team surprise everyone or live up to expectations?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK Singles Chart #1

angles.name: Chart Topper Reign
angles.copy: 20 WEEKS AT NUMBER ONE! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still dominating the UK Singles Chart. What a track! #ReinMeIn

angles.name: New Entries Shine
angles.copy: Ariana Grande and Sienna Spiro are lighting up the new UK Singles Chart with fresh entries. Who's got your favourite new track?

angles.name: Iconic Influence
angles.copy: From 'Like a Virgin' to global superstar, Madonna turns 68! Her influence on pop music is undeniable. Celebrate the legend with us!

angles.name: Go-Go's Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating Belinda Carlisle's 68th birthday! From The Go-Go's to her solo hits, she's a true rock and pop icon.

angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 37th Birthday to Joe Jonas! Still bringing the pop anthems.

moments.title: Summer Holidays Continue Across the UK
moments.blurb: School summer holidays are in full swing across England, Wales and Northern Ireland, with most students returning to school in early September, while Scottish schools typically resume mid-August.

angles.name: Holiday Vibes
angles.copy: Summer holidays are still going strong for many across the UK! What are your plans for the last few weeks of freedom?

moments.title: Welsh Government Appoints Town Centre Taskforce Co-Chairs
moments.blurb: The Welsh Government has announced the co-chairs for a new Town Centre Taskforce, aimed at providing expert advice and support for the future of Wales' town centres, with funding confirmed for Bangor and Bridgend.

angles.name: Revitalising Welsh Towns
angles.copy: Big news for Welsh town centres! A new taskforce has been appointed to help revitalise high streets across Wales. What changes would you love to see in your local town?

angles.name: Bangor & Bridgend Boost
angles.copy: Funding confirmed for Bangor and Bridgend town centres! Great to see investment in our local communities.

moments.title: Travellers Return to Exeter Park
moments.blurb: An unauthorised encampment has returned to Wonford Playing Fields in Exeter, just days after a previous group was evicted, prompting Exeter City Council to plan further protective measures.

angles.name: Wonford Fields Update
angles.copy: Travellers have returned to Wonford Playing Fields in Exeter. Exeter City Council says they're taking steps to regain possession of the land. More on Radio Exe.

angles.name: Local Impact
angles.copy: Local residents are once again impacted by an unauthorised encampment at Wonford Playing Fields. We'll keep you updated on the latest from Exeter.

moments.title: Firefighters Tackle Large Exeter Grassland Fire
moments.blurb: Fire crews continue to tackle a large fire that broke out across 50 acres of land at Mincinglake Valley Park in Exeter on August 11, with residents advised to avoid the area due to smoke.

angles.name: Mincinglake Fire Alert
angles.copy: Firefighters are still at Mincinglake Valley Park in Exeter after a large grassland fire. Please avoid the area if possible due to smoke. Stay safe, Exeter.

angles.name: Devon Fire Update
angles.copy: Our thoughts are with the crews tackling the Mincinglake Valley Park fire. Updates on air and online, stay informed with Radio Exe.

moments.title: Devon Council Challenges Local Government Reorganisation
moments.blurb: Devon County Council has initiated legal proceedings against the government's decision to reorganise local government in Devon and Torbay, citing concerns over the impact on rural communities.

angles.name: Devon's Legal Fight

angles.name: Rural Community Impact
angles.copy: Devon CC is fighting for rural communities in its challenge to government's reorganisation plans. Tune into Radio Exe for the latest updates.

moments.title: Wales Offers Rates Relief for EV Charging
moments.blurb: The Welsh Government has announced 100% non-domestic rates relief for electric vehicle charging bays and forecourts across Wales until 2036, aiming to boost EV infrastructure.

angles.name: EV Boost in Wales
angles.copy: Great news for electric vehicle owners and businesses in Wales! New rates relief aims to supercharge our EV charging network.

angles.name: Future of Transport
angles.copy: Wales is plugging into the future! 100% rates relief for EV charging until 2036. What does this mean for your area?

moments.title: Report Highlights Pembrokeshire Housing Crisis
moments.blurb: A new report from the Bevan Foundation, launched at the National Eisteddfod in Pembrokeshire, addresses the loss of homes to holiday accommodation across Wales, urging national action.

angles.name: Pembrokeshire Housing Debate

angles.name: Homes or Holidays?
angles.copy: The debate over homes vs. holiday accommodation continues in Wales, with a new report calling for national action. How does this affect your community?
